page.overview:
Who is Beta Pixl?

The Beta Pixl is one of the many beta elements of Super Paper Mario. It, as the given name suggests, is a pixl. It looks like a ladder and was cut from the game for unknown reasons. Some people say this is an early version of Carrie, when Super Paper Mario was still going to be on the GameCube. They think this due to the odd wing position of this pixl which is similar to that of Carrie's.
